purpose: The DESNZ sub-national domestic electricity and gas meter counts for every Great Britain local authority, 2024 (gas meters over electricity meters give the share of each authority's census households bound as gas-connected), and Northern Ireland's sub-national domestic electricity and gas consumption, 2024 (the N92000002 row, all domestic meters: Great Britain's part of the stage's UK level the authority kWh rows are levelled to, Energy Trends or for electricity the kWh ONS household spending buys (microcosm#1418), is its share of the sub-national total with this row added, microcosm#1278). Consumed by the local energy appliers (uk_runtime.domestic_energy_targets, microcosm#1207).
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.

attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (Department for Energy Security and Net Zero, sub-national electricity and gas consumption statistics, Great Britain and Northern Ireland).
